title: 36 Hours: Park City, Utah
abstract: On and off the slopes, there’s plenty to do in this Rockies resort town. Sure you can shop and eat. But try barreling down an Olympic bobsled trail at 80 m.p.h.

title: 36 Hours: Penang, Malaysia
abstract: Smart restaurants, a lively art scene and a spate of new boutique hotels: There’s more to this exotic island than its famous noodle soup.

title: 36 Hours in New Orleans
abstract: This is how they do it in New Orleans, a city that was four-fifths underwater less than seven years ago and is hosting this year’s Final Four basketball tournament.

title: 36 Hours: New Orleans
abstract: The days leading up to Mardi Gras, Feb. 21 this year, fuse into one long celebration, as the city begins to fill up with floats, and anticipation rules.

title: 36 Hours in Bruges, Belgium
abstract: Much of the enchanting city center truly is reminiscent of a fairy tale, with cobblestone lanes curving past turreted houses.

title: 36 Hours: Bruges, Belgium
abstract: More than quiet medieval canals and cobbled lanes, this city offers ambitious restaurants, new and renovated museums and, after dark, cozy pubs selling rare Belgian beers.
